description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of the length of the gold prefix, comparing two conditions: “Consistency: wait-1” (blue dashed line with circle markers) and “Inconsistency: wait-9” (orange solid line with square markers). The x-axis, labeled “the length of gold prefix,” ranges from 0 to 20 and uses a linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 23 to 29 and also uses a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The blue line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 24.7 at x=0, dips to a minimum of about 23.8 at x=2, then rises steadily to a final value of approximately 28.1 at x=20. The orange line begins at a BLEU score of 25.2 at x=0, fluctuates with minor peaks and troughs around the 25.0–25.5 range, and ends at approximately 25.7 at x=20.
